event: Launch week: an easing of content difficulty is announced, then partly reversed the same day because stages had become easier than intended; stages get harder again after the fix.
The power gate becomes public: a gallery post publishes crumblehub's bracket table (99% of recommended power → 75% final damage, 100% → 100%, capped at 120%).
A community sheet lists the entry power of every bracket (1% to 120%) for stages 1-1 to 100-30.
Update 1.3.002: main stages extended to 328-30 (80 new chapters) and daily dungeons to 570.
Last documented pre-easing 35% clears: 248-30 GingerCraven at 801.5M and 243-30 at 693.5M, from one pusher's series.

Update 1.4.002: main stages 169-1 to 328-30 eased (recommended power, enemy ATK and HP down by up to 36%; 328-30 from 15.61G to 10.00G), bosses of 169-1 to 248-30 rebalanced, the Dimensional Rift (차원의 이면) opens for players who cleared 328-30 (season 1 to 2026-10-08) with the Rift-only pet 무한바퀴, daily dungeons to 770, and a new stat, 스킬준비.
First players reach the Rift; the top player ND러너 enters third across all servers. Clears of 328-30 reported at 4.2G, the 35% line.
26 players are in the Rift across all servers; the leader is at level 7.
First screenshot-documented 15% clears past 300 (301-27 and 301-28 at 2.05G, manual, Brightseeker–Bari–Cherry Cola).
The Rift's leader is at level 19; one guild holds most of the top ranks.
Rift season 1 ends (scheduled); seasons from 2026-10-08 use levels 101–200, whose recommended power restarts at 16.7G.
